description: This file defines an abstract test class for streaming resilience tests in an Orleans-based project. It contains multiple asynchronous test methods that check behavior after stream inactivity, deactivation, and under slow subscriber conditions. It manages stream providers, grains, and stream interactions to validate correct stream recovery and event counting.

classes.name: StreamingResumeTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for streaming resilience tests, providing common setup and utility for various test scenarios.

methods.name: ResumeAfterInactivity
methods.description: Test that verifies stream resumes correctly after inactivity period.

methods.name: ResumeAfterInactivityNotInCache
methods.description: Test that verifies stream resumes correctly after inactivity when cache is not used.

methods.name: ResumeAfterInactivityImpl
methods.description: Private implementation for testing stream resume after inactivity, with options to wait for cache flush.

methods.name: ResumeAfterDeactivation
methods.description: Test that verifies stream resumes after the grain deactivates.

methods.name: ResumeAfterDeactivationActiveStream
methods.description: Test that verifies stream resumes correctly when active streams are present during deactivation.

methods.name: ResumeAfterSlowSubscriber
methods.description: Test that verifies stream delivery to a slow subscriber is handled correctly.
